requirements.title: Complete original source

requiredEvidence: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.
requirements.remediation: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.

assessmentProcedure.positive: Open a genuine admitted original and every enclosing funding/history parent independently in both endpoint processes.
assessmentProcedure.negative: Change one byte; omit a parent; substitute artwork, JSON flags, an unsupported schema or an oversized carrier.
assessmentProcedure.concurrencyAndInterruption: Interrupt storage/import/export between each retained block; reopen the identical original after restart.
assessmentProcedure.acceptanceCriteria: Both independent readers derive the same admitted closure and source digest; every mutation refuses before authority or credit.
evidenceToRetain: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.
assessmentProcedure.retest: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.

assessmentProcedure.acceptanceCriteria: Actual executable/resource hashes and trust policy match the declared profile; altered or mixed trust material refuses; diagnostic roots never produce production authority.

Qualify real signatures, revocation, expiry and changed terms; audit logs/caches/model access for private keys, tokens, attestation and execution handles.
Exercise real concurrent, repeated and cross-device claims with one accepted credit; inspect durable participant and global state after interruption.
Inject lost responses/crashes at every irreversible boundary on the actual durable adapter. Reopen the same accepted original without staging a replacement.
Reverify full authentic funding, handover, credit/cancellation and account openings. A digest, HTTP result or caller report is insufficient.
capabilities.remediation: Implement the linked contract and qualify each selected operation against original admitted sources, actual adapter and environment.

capabilities.title: Source, history and independent replay
capabilities.obligation: Keep complete originals, unknown namespaces and verified causal coordinates through every transport and reopening.
requiredEvidence: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.
Reproduce exact resources and independently assess the deployed signer/root policy; custom-root fixtures cannot qualify production.
Reopen actual ownership transitions; reject stale heads, former-owner execution, missing history and conflicting branches.
Verify real source-bound KKS coordinates and predecessor order under pinned resources; reject bare timestamp or pulse substitutions.
Reverify full authentic funding, handover, credit/cancellation and account openings. A digest, HTTP result or caller report is insufficient.
Round-trip actual originals across process/device and transport; compare exact hashes, unknown namespaces and canonical reopened heads.
capabilities.remediation: Implement the linked contract and qualify each selected operation against original admitted sources, actual adapter and environment.

capabilities.title: Financial application integrity
capabilities.obligation: Separate retained, received, confirmed and spendable states. Preserve local first paint, freshness, protected custody and scope of execution.
requiredEvidence: Qualify real signatures, revocation, expiry and changed terms; audit logs/caches/model access for private keys, tokens, attestation and execution handles.
Inject lost responses/crashes at every irreversible boundary on the actual durable adapter. Reopen the same accepted original without staging a replacement.
Reverify full authentic funding, handover, credit/cancellation and account openings. A digest, HTTP result or caller report is insufficient.
Exercise cold/offline first paint, outages, delayed reads and reconnect on actual browser/device. Retention must not create credit or attest successful refresh.
Independent assessment of every applicable invariant with admitted real sources, actual production writer and qualified hardware. Reference checks do not satisfy this gate.
capabilities.remediation: Implement the linked contract and qualify each selected operation against original admitted sources, actual adapter and environment.
